facts.raw_span: A 61-year-old man
20-year history of recurrent episodes of abdominal pain, bloating, and obstipation, alternating with intermittent diarrhea
30-lb weight loss
heavy alcohol use (12–24 beers daily for 20 years)
uncomplicated cholecystectomy 10 years earlier
no abnormalities on colonoscopy and esophagogastroduodenoscopy
no evidence of celiac disease
exploratory laparotomy showed no mechanical cause of the obstructions
CT scan showed small-bowel dilation (approximately 23 mm in diameter) consistent with obstruction
megacolon dilated up to 15 cm
low levels of fat-soluble vitamins: vitamin A 22 µg/dL
gluten-free diet trialed for 3 months produced no improvement
